title: Ultimate Fuck Valentine's Day Playlist for Metalheads
contentHtml:
Valentine's Day is one of two things for people: either filled with love and family, or filled almost to the brim with hatred and anger. This article is just as it is titled for the second type of people. Here is the Ultimate Fuck Valentine’s Day Playlist.

30. "Through It All" by From Ashes to New
29. “True Whorror” by Leviathan
28. “Fucked With a Knife” by Cannibal Corpse
27. “Vagina Curse” by Love Sex Machine
26. “From the Kettle onto the Coil” by Deafheaven
25. “You Give Love a Bad Name” by Bon Jovi
24. “The Resistance” by Fit For a King
21. “Overlord” by Lamb of God
20. “Driftwood” by Cult Leader
19. “Green Eyes” by iwrestledabearonce
18. “Vestal Disfigurement Upon The Sacred Chantry” by Aborted
17. “Slut” by Benighted
16. “Purity” by Slipknot
15. “Six” by All That Remains
14. “I Hate Myself For Loving You” by Joan Jett
13. “Siberian Kiss” by Glassjaw
12. “Let Me Burn” by Whitechapel
11. “She’s My Rushmore” by Every Time I Die
10. “MX” by Deftones
 9. “The Bleeding” by Five Finger Death Punch
 8. “Whore to a Chainsaw” by Thy Art is Murder
7. “Always” by Saliva
6. “Cuntcrusher” by Infant Annihilator
5.“No Need for Introductions…” by Bring Me The Horizon
 4 “This Love” by Pantera
3. “Romance is Dead” by Parkway Drive
 2. “The Last Relapse” by All Shall Perish
 1. “Hot Soap” by My Ticket Home


​- Metal Lifestyle Team.
